===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Instructor Ng]].
* Complete the [[Advanced Defense Techniques]] course.
* Complete the [[Disruption]] course. 
* Complete the [[Skill Chaining]] course. 
* Complete the [[Snaring Course|Snaring]] course. 
* See [[Headmaster Greico]] for your reward. 

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* 1 [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng.  The order of completion is entirely optional.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;[[Headmaster Greico]]
:''"You are ready to earn your Ranger insignia? All right, then. This advanced training is designed to teach you the nuances of the Ranger's art: controlling nature, using advanced bow attacks, and hindering your enemies with Conditions. Rangers commune with nature, summoning Spirits that alter the envirnment for both friend and foe: thay can also lay deadly Traps and, of course, damage enemies with powerful ranged attacks. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin your training."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready to earn my Ranger Insignia.

| ask = It was my understanding that you wished to become an expert Ranger. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin training for your Ranger Insignia.

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Greico'''
:''"Congratulations. You have earned your Ranger Insignia. You are now an expert Ranger. May Melandru guide your arrows."''
